name: code-explorer
title: CodeExplorer (ce): Local Code Architecture Graph & CI Gates
description: Indexes polyglot repositories into a single local SQLite graph (.codeexplorer/graph.db). Gives coding agents and engineers cross-service call chains, SQL table lineage, task context packs, and Cypher invariant gates over MCP and CLI.
dataHandling: Runs entirely on the developer machine; source code and the graph database never leave the workspace.
